content: Lord Jesus, you are the Good Shepherd, and my friend listening tonight shall not want. Make them lie down in green pastures and lead them beside still waters. Restore their soul. Even in the valley of the shadow, let them fear no evil, for you are with them. Let goodness and mercy follow them all their days. In Jesus' name, amen.

Heavenly Father, your word says I will both lay me down in peace and sleep, for you alone make me dwell in safety. For the one lying awake right now, quiet the racing mind and settle the restless heart. Be their safety tonight, Lord, and give them sweet and healing sleep. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you are the keeper who never slumbers nor sleeps. Watch over every trucker on the highway and every traveler on the road tonight. Keep their going out and their coming in. Be the shade at their right hand, and bring each one safely home. In the name of Jesus, amen.

God our refuge and strength, you are a very present help in trouble. Though the ground shakes under my friend tonight and everything familiar seems to be slipping into the sea, help them not to fear. Hold them steady in your strong hands. In Jesus' name, amen.

Most High God, I pray for the one who needs shelter tonight. Let them dwell in the secret place of the Most High and abide under the shadow of the Almighty. Teach their heart to say, you are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you are near to the brokenhearted and you save those who are crushed in spirit. Draw near right now to the one whose heart is in pieces tonight. Let them feel that you have not stepped away from their pain but stepped into it. Hold them close. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For everyone crying in the dark hours tonight, I ask that you would hold their tears and hold their hearts. Carry them through this night, and let the morning bring new joy. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, some of my friends listening tonight feel cast down, and their soul is disquieted within them. Lift their eyes to hope in you. Remind them that they shall yet praise you, for you are the help of their countenance and their God. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Lord, you are our light and our salvation, so whom shall we fear? For the one gripped by fear tonight, be their light in the darkness. You are the strength of their life. Drive back every shadow and let them rest in your strong protection. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, your word gives us a simple prayer for frightened hearts: what time I am afraid, I will trust in you. Teach my friend that prayer tonight. When fear rises, let trust rise higher. Let them put their whole weight on your faithfulness. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you are a shield around us, our glory, and the lifter of our heads. For the one whose head is hanging low tonight, gently lift it. Let them lie down and sleep, and wake again, because you sustain them. In the strong name of Jesus, amen.

Heavenly Father, you give your beloved sleep. For those who have worked themselves weary and still cannot rest, free them from the anxious toil of trying to hold everything together. Let them release it all to you and receive the gift of rest. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, there is nowhere we can go from your Spirit. If we take the wings of the morning and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea, even there your hand leads us. Wherever my friend is tonight, a hospital, a cell, a truck cab, a quiet house, let them know your right hand holds them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Creator God, you knit each of us together in our mother's womb, and we are fearfully and wonderfully made. For the one who feels worthless tonight, speak your truth over them. You made them with care, and your works are marvelous. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you heal the broken in heart and bind up their wounds. I lift up everyone carrying a wound tonight that no one else can see. Bind it up with your tender hands, Great Physician, and begin the healing only you can do. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, let my friend bless you tonight and forget not all your benefits. You forgive all our iniquities and heal all our diseases. You redeem our lives from destruction and crown us with lovingkindness and tender mercies. Renew their youth like the eagle's. In Jesus' name, amen.

Heavenly Father, as a father pities his children, so you pity those who fear you, for you know our frame and remember that we are dust. For the one who feels weak and ashamed of it tonight, let them know you are tender toward them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, your word says commit your way unto the Lord, trust also in him, and he shall bring it to pass. Help my friend commit the decision they are carrying tonight into your hands, and give them the trust to leave it there. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you told us to cast our burden on you, and you will sustain us. You will never suffer the righteous to be moved. Help my friend take the heavy load off their shoulders tonight and lay it at your feet. Hold them up, Lord. In Jesus' name, amen.

God our refuge, you invite us to trust in you at all times and pour out our hearts before you. For the one who has held it in too long, give them freedom to pour it all out to you tonight, every word and every tear. You can hold it all. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father to the fatherless and defender of widows, you set the solitary in families. I pray for everyone listening who feels alone tonight. Surround them with your presence, and bring them people who will love them like family. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, my flesh and my heart may fail, but you are the strength of my heart and my portion forever. For the one whose body is weak and whose heart is tired tonight, be their strength. Be their portion when everything else feels like too little. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord God, you are a sun and a shield. You give grace and glory, and no good thing will you withhold from those who walk uprightly. For the one worried about what they lack tonight, assure them of your goodness and your care. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you are good and ready to forgive, and plenteous in mercy to all who call upon you. For the one who thinks they have gone too far, let them hear that you are ready, right now, to forgive. Let them call on you tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Eternal God, teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom. For our older saints listening tonight, thank you for every year you have given them. Let their remaining days be full of wisdom and your presence. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, in the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul. For the one whose thoughts are spinning tonight, gather up those anxious thoughts and replace them with your comfort. Let delight return to their soul. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, we make a joyful noise to you tonight. We know that you are God, that you made us, and that we are your people and the sheep of your pasture. We enter your gates with thanksgiving, for you are good and your mercy is everlasting. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, when your people cried to you in their trouble, you made the storm a calm and brought them to their desired haven. For the one caught in a storm tonight, still the waves, Lord, and bring them safely into the harbor. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, this is the day which you have made, and we will rejoice and be glad in it. For those starting their day in the middle of the night, the shift workers and the early risers, give them joy for this day you have made. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, my soul waits for you more than watchmen wait for the morning. I pray for everyone keeping watch tonight, the nurses, the guards, the night crews. As they wait for the dawn, let them find their hope in your word. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you show us the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy, and at your right hand are pleasures forevermore. For the one who has lost their way tonight, show them the path again and fill them with joy in your presence. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, show my friend your ways and teach them your paths. Lead them in your truth, for you are the God of their salvation, and on you they wait all the day. For the one facing a crossroads tonight, make the next step clear. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, our times are in your hand. For the one waiting on a test result, a phone call, or a verdict tonight, remind them that their times are held by you. Not one moment is outside your care. Give them peace while they wait. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you are our hiding place. You preserve us from trouble and compass us about with songs of deliverance. As these hymns play tonight, let my friend hear in them your songs of deliverance, wrapped all around them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you heard the cry of the one who waited patiently, and you brought him up out of the horrible pit and the miry clay. You set his feet upon a rock. For the one stuck in the pit tonight, lift them out, and put a new song in their mouth. In Jesus' name, amen.

Create in us a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within us. For the one who has fallen and feels far from you tonight, do not cast them away from your presence. Restore unto them the joy of your salvation. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, David remembered you upon his bed and meditated on you in the night watches. Because you had been his help, he rejoiced in the shadow of your wings. For those awake right now, turn these sleepless hours into sweet time with you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, your servant prayed, cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails. I lift up every older saint listening tonight. Stay close as their strength fades, and let them know they still matter to you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, the psalmist called to remembrance his song in the night. For those who are troubled and cannot sleep tonight, bring back to mind the songs of faith they learned long ago. Let an old hymn become their prayer. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, your word is a lamp unto our feet and a light unto our path. For the one who cannot see the way ahead tonight, give them just enough light for the next step. Let your word guide them safely home. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, your servant said his eyes were awake through the night watches, that he might meditate in your word. For everyone awake at this hour, let their minds turn to your promises. Make this night a holy meeting place. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, cause us to hear your lovingkindness in the morning, for in you do we trust. Cause us to know the way wherein we should walk. For the one dreading tomorrow, let morning come with fresh reminders of your faithful love. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you said be still, and know that I am God. Quiet the noise around my friend tonight and the noise inside them too. Let them be still long enough to know that you are God, and that you are still in control. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, precious in your sight is the death of your saints. For the family grieving a loved one tonight, comfort them with this truth. Their loved one was precious to you in life and precious to you in death. Hold the ones left behind. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, they that sow in tears shall reap in joy. For the one who has been weeping as they go, sowing prayers for a loved one for years, let them hold on. Bring them back rejoicing, bringing their sheaves with them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you will perfect that which concerns me. Your mercy endures forever. For the one worried about unfinished things tonight, remind them that you finish what you start. You will not forsake the works of your own hands. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, your servant once said no man cared for his soul, and then he cried to you, you are my refuge and my portion. For the prisoner in a cell and the person alone tonight, be their refuge. Let them know you care for their soul. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you will regard the prayer of the destitute and not despise their prayer. For the one who has nothing left tonight, no money, no strength, no answers, let them know you are not looking down on them. You hear them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, your servant was weary with groaning and watered his couch with tears, yet he could say, the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping. For the one crying into their pillow tonight, let them know you have heard and you will receive their prayer. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, the angel of the Lord encamps round about those who fear you, and delivers them. Station your angels around every police officer, firefighter, and paramedic on duty tonight, and bring each one home safe. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you give your angels charge over us to keep us in all our ways. Guard our soldiers serving far from home tonight. Bear them up in their hands, and bring them safely back to the people who love them. In Jesus' name, amen.

God, give the king your judgments, and your righteousness unto the king's son. We pray tonight for those who lead our nation, our states, and our towns. Give them wisdom, integrity, and a heart for justice and mercy. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you keep in perfect peace the one whose mind is stayed on you, because they trust in you. For the restless mind tonight, help my friend fix their thoughts on you, and give them that perfect peace. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you give power to the faint, and to those with no might you increase strength. Those who wait on you shall renew their strength. For the weary worker and caregiver tonight, let them mount up with wings as eagles, run and not be weary. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you said fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God. Strengthen my friend tonight. Help them and uphold them with the right hand of your righteousness, so they do not have to stand alone. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, when we pass through the waters, you will be with us, and through the rivers, they shall not overflow us. When we walk through the fire, we shall not be burned. Whatever my friend is passing through tonight, go through it with them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you bore our griefs and carried our sorrows. You were wounded for our transgressions, and with your stripes we are healed. For the one who is sick tonight, I ask for your healing touch on their body and their soul. In your holy name, amen.

Good Shepherd, you gather the lambs with your arm and carry them in your bosom, and you gently lead those that are with young. For every tired mother and father up with a little one tonight, lead them gently and give them strength. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you said even to your old age I am he, and even to gray hairs will I carry you. For our older friends listening tonight, thank you that you have carried them this far. Keep carrying them, every step of the way home. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, a mother may forget her nursing child, yet you will not forget us. You have engraved us upon the palms of your hands. For the one who feels forgotten tonight, let them know their name is written on your hands. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, I pray for the one listening who does not yet know you. Let them seek you while you may be found, and call upon you while you are near. You will have mercy and abundantly pardon. Let tonight be the night they turn to you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you came to bind up the brokenhearted and proclaim liberty to the captives. Give my friend tonight beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, a bruised reed you will not break, and smoking flax you will not quench. For the one who feels bruised and barely flickering tonight, thank you for your gentleness. Fan that small flame back to life. In the gentle name of Jesus, amen.

Holy One, you said in returning and rest shall you be saved, in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength. Teach my friend tonight to stop striving, to return to you, and to find strength in quiet confidence. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you promised that our ears would hear a word behind us saying, this is the way, walk in it. For the one who does not know which way to turn tonight, speak clearly, and give them courage to follow. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, the mountains shall depart and the hills be removed, but your kindness shall not depart from us, neither shall your covenant of peace be removed. When everything shakes tonight, let my friend rest in your unshakable kindness. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you promised to guide your people continually and satisfy their soul in drought. Make my friend like a watered garden tonight, like a spring of water whose waters fail not, even in this dry season. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you invite us, come now, and let us reason together. Though our sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. For the one carrying guilt tonight, wash them clean through the precious blood of Jesus. In his name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you are Wonderful, Counselor, the Mighty God, the Everlasting Father, the Prince of Peace. Be the counselor for the confused tonight, the mighty God for the weak, the Father for the fatherless, and the Prince of Peace for the anxious. Amen.

Lord God, you will swallow up death in victory and wipe away tears from off all faces. For everyone grieving tonight, give them a taste of that promise now, and hold them until the day you wipe every tear away. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you told us not to dwell on the former things, for you are doing a new thing. You make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. For the one stuck in the past tonight, open their eyes to the new thing you are doing. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you know the thoughts that you think toward us, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give us an expected end, a future and a hope. For the one who sees no future tonight, show them your good plans. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you have loved us with an everlasting love, and with lovingkindness you have drawn us. For the one who feels unlovable tonight, draw them gently with your kindness and let them know your love has no end. In Jesus' name, amen.

Ah Lord God, you made the heavens and the earth by your great power, and there is nothing too hard for you. For the impossible situation my friend is facing tonight, we bring it to you, the God of the impossible. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, it is of your mercies that we are not consumed, because your compassions fail not. They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness. For the one who failed today, let tomorrow begin with fresh mercy. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you told the weeping mother to refrain her voice from weeping, for her children would come again from the land of the enemy. For every parent praying for a prodigal tonight, bring their children home. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you will not cast off forever. Though you cause grief, yet you will have compassion according to the multitude of your mercies, for you do not afflict willingly. For the one who feels abandoned tonight, let them see your compassion. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you go before us, you are with us, and you will not fail us nor forsake us. Let my friend not fear or be dismayed about tomorrow. You are already there, waiting for them with grace enough for every hour. In Jesus' name, amen.

Eternal God, you are our refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms. For the one who feels like they are falling tonight, catch them. Let them feel your arms underneath, strong and never tiring. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you commanded Joshua, be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go. Give that same courage to my friend tonight as they face what lies ahead. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, bless my friend and keep them. Make your face shine upon them and be gracious unto them. Lift up your countenance upon them, and give them peace, tonight and every night, in every room and on every road. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you told your people the Lord shall fight for you, and you shall hold your peace. For the one who is battle weary tonight, let them stand still and watch you fight for them. Let them rest while you work. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, the joy of the Lord is our strength. For the one whose strength is gone tonight, fill them with your joy, not a joy that depends on circumstances, but the deep joy that comes from you alone. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, help my friend trust in you with all their heart and lean not unto their own understanding. In all their ways let them acknowledge you, and you shall direct their paths. Straighten out the tangled road ahead. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, your name is a strong tower; the righteous run into it and are safe. For the one who needs somewhere to run tonight, let them run to you and find safety inside your name. In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

Father, we pray for the parents listening tonight. Help them train up their children in the way they should go. Give them patience, wisdom, and love, and let the seeds they plant bear fruit for years to come. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord our God, you are mighty in the midst of your people. You rejoice over us with joy, you rest in your love, and you joy over us with singing. Quiet my friend with your love tonight, and let them sense you singing over them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines, yet we will rejoice in you. For the one who lost their job or their income this week, help them joy in the God of their salvation, and provide for them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, your word says when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the Lord shall be a light unto me. For the one fighting addiction who fell again today, lift them up. Be their light tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, what others meant for evil, you meant for good. For the one who has been wronged and betrayed tonight, I ask you to take what was done to them and turn it for good, just as you did for Joseph. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you told Jacob, I am with you, and will keep you in all places wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. Keep every traveler tonight, on the road, in the air, or at sea, and bring them home. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, when David was greatly distressed and the people spoke of turning against him, he encouraged himself in the Lord his God. For the one with no one to encourage them tonight, be their encouragement. Strengthen them from within. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you promised that if your people would humble themselves, pray, seek your face, and turn from their wicked ways, you would hear from heaven and heal their land. Start with us, Lord. Bring revival to our nation. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, like King Jehoshaphat we pray, we know not what to do, but our eyes are upon you. For the one facing more than they can handle tonight, let them fix their eyes on you and watch you work. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord God of Israel, under whose wings we have come to trust, I pray for every widow listening tonight. As you cared for Ruth and Naomi, care for them. Give them a full reward and provide for every need. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, with Job we declare, I know that my redeemer lives, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth. For the one who stood at a graveside this week, let that hope rise in their heart tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, to everything there is a season: a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance. For the one in a season of mourning, give them freedom to grieve, and the hope that dancing will come again. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, unto those who fear your name, the Sun of righteousness shall arise with healing in his wings. For every sick and suffering listener tonight, rise over them with healing. Let them go forth strong again. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you promised to restore the years that the locust has eaten. For the one grieving years lost to addiction, regret, or wasted time, restore what was lost. Let the years ahead be fruitful for your glory. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you promised to make the valley of Achor, the valley of trouble, a door of hope. For the one deep in a valley of trouble tonight, open a door of hope right where they are, and let them sing again. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, when Elijah lay exhausted under a juniper tree, ready to give up, you sent an angel to touch him and say, arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you. For the one burned out tonight, refresh them gently. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you promised Moses, my presence shall go with you, and I will give you rest. Let your presence go with my friend through this night and into tomorrow, and give them deep and lasting rest. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it. I pray for every marriage under strain tonight. Rekindle the love that was there, and protect it from every flood that would wash it away. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, two are better than one, and a threefold cord is not quickly broken. For every husband and wife listening tonight, be the third strand in their marriage. Bind them together with you at the center. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, the three Hebrew young men said our God is able to deliver us, but if not, we will not bow. Give that courage to our brothers and sisters persecuted for their faith tonight. Stand with them in the fire. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you said come unto me, all you that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. My friend is tired tonight. Let them take your yoke, which is easy, and find rest unto their soul. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you told us to take no thought for our life, what we shall eat or drink or wear. Our Father feeds the birds of the air, and we are worth much more to him. For the one worried about bills tonight, let them trust his care. In your name, amen.

Father, help my friend seek first your kingdom and your righteousness, trusting that all these things shall be added unto them. Help them take no thought for tomorrow, but leave tomorrow in your hands tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you said blessed are they that mourn, for they shall be comforted. For the one mourning tonight, keep your promise. Send your comfort in ways they can feel, through your Spirit and through your people. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you said we are the light of the world. For believers going into workplaces tonight and tomorrow, let their light so shine that others see their good works and glorify our Father in heaven. In your name, amen.

Lord of the harvest, you were moved with compassion for the crowds, scattered like sheep with no shepherd. Send forth laborers into your harvest. Bless every missionary and pastor serving tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, when Peter began to sink, you immediately stretched forth your hand and caught him. For the one sinking in fear tonight, reach out your hand and catch them. Say to them, be of good cheer, it is I. In your name, amen.

Good Shepherd, you leave the ninety and nine to go after the one that has gone astray. For every wandering son and daughter tonight, go after them, find them, and carry them home rejoicing. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you promised, lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world. For the one who feels alone at this hour, let them know you are with them right now, in this very room. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you arose and rebuked the wind and said unto the sea, peace, be still, and there was a great calm. Speak those words over the storm in my friend's life tonight. Bring a great calm. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you told the woman who touched your garment, daughter, your faith has made you whole; go in peace. For the one reaching for you tonight in sickness, let them feel your healing power and your peace. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you said suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not. I lift up every child tonight, the sick ones, the scared ones, and the ones in hard homes. Hold them in your arms. In your name, amen.

Father, when the prodigal son was yet a great way off, his father saw him, had compassion, and ran to him. For every prodigal listening tonight, let them know you are running toward them with open arms. In Jesus' name, amen.
Lord Jesus, you came to seek and to save that which was lost. For the one who feels lost tonight, find them right where they are. Save them, and bring them into your family. In your name, amen.

Father, with you nothing shall be impossible. For the diagnosis, the debt, the broken relationship, or the addiction that seems impossible tonight, we place it before the God of the impossible. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, the dying thief said remember me when you come into your kingdom, and you said today you shall be with me in paradise. For the prisoner listening tonight, let them know it is never too late to call on you. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, when you saw the grieving widow, you had compassion on her and said, weep not. For the one weeping over a loss tonight, let them see your compassion and feel your nearness. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you told Martha she was careful and troubled about many things. For every caregiver worn out from caring for others tonight, help them sit at your feet, even for a moment, and be refreshed. In your name, amen.

Lord, you taught that people ought always to pray and not to faint. For the one who has been praying a long time without an answer tonight, keep them from giving up. Strengthen them to keep praying. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you so loved the world that you gave your only begotten Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have everlasting life. For the one who has never trusted Jesus, let them believe tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you said let not your heart be troubled; in my Father's house are many mansions. For the family missing someone who has gone home to you, comfort them with the hope of the place you have prepared. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you said peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you, not as the world gives. Let not my friend's heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid. Give them your peace tonight. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you told us that in this world we would have tribulation, but to be of good cheer, because you have overcome the world. For the one overwhelmed by trouble tonight, remind them that you have already overcome. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, the thief comes to steal, kill, and destroy, but you came that we might have life more abundantly. You are the Good Shepherd who laid down your life for the sheep. Give my friend abundant life tonight. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, your sheep hear your voice, and no one is able to pluck them out of your hand or your Father's hand. For the one afraid of losing their faith tonight, let them rest secure in your grip. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you said him that comes to me I will in no wise cast out. For the one afraid they are too broken to come tonight, assure them that you will never turn them away. In your precious name, amen.

Lord Jesus, if the Son makes you free, you shall be free indeed. For every person bound by addiction tonight, whether drugs, alcohol, gambling, or anything else, break those chains. Set them free indeed. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you are the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in you, though they die, yet shall they live. For the grieving family tonight, let this hope be an anchor for their hearts. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you wept at the grave of your friend Lazarus. You know the sting of loss. For the one crying over a loved one tonight, thank you that you weep with them and you understand. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you are the vine and we are the branches; without you we can do nothing. Help my friend abide in you tonight, drawing life and strength from you alone, and bearing much fruit. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you laid down your life for us and called us your friends. For the lonely listener tonight who feels they have no friends, let them know they have a friend in you who will never leave. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you offer living water, and whoever drinks of it shall never thirst. For the one trying to fill their emptiness with things that never satisfy, let them drink of you tonight. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you are the light of the world, and whoever follows you shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life. Shine into the dark places of my friend's heart tonight. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, after Peter denied you, you restored him by the sea and asked him three times, do you love me? For the one who has failed you and feels disqualified tonight, restore them. In your name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you told Peter, I have prayed for you, that your faith fail not. Thank you that you are praying for my friend tonight. Keep their faith from failing, and when they are restored, use them to strengthen others. In your name, amen.

Father, we know that all things work together for good to them that love you, to them who are called according to your purpose. Take the hard things in my friend's life tonight and work them together for good. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, nothing can separate us from your love in Christ Jesus, not death, not life, not angels, not things present, not things to come. Let my friend rest tonight in a love that cannot be lost. In Jesus' name, amen.

Holy Spirit, when we know not what we should pray for, you intercede for us with groanings which cannot be uttered. For the one with no words left tonight, pray for them, and carry their sighs to the Father. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, your word says if we confess with our mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in our heart that you raised him from the dead, we shall be saved. For the one ready to believe tonight, let them call on Jesus right now. In his name, amen.

Father, you showed your love toward us in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us. For the one who thinks they must clean up before coming to you, let them know you loved them first. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, as your word instructs, we pray for kings and for all who are in authority, that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life. Give our leaders wisdom, humility, and integrity tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, no temptation has taken us but such as is common to man. You are faithful, and with every temptation you make a way to escape. For the one tempted tonight, show them the way out, and give them strength to take it. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, love suffers long and is kind. Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Pour this kind of love into every marriage and family listening tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, thanks be to you, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ. For the one who wonders if their faithful work matters, remind them their labor is not in vain in the Lord. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father of mercies and God of all comfort, you comfort us in all our tribulation so that we can comfort others. Comfort my friend tonight, and one day let them pass that comfort on. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, we are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; perplexed, but not in despair; persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed. Hold up our persecuted brothers and sisters around the world tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, if anyone is in Christ, they are a new creature; old things are passed away, and all things are become new. For the one ashamed of who they used to be, let them see who they are now in Christ. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you said my grace is sufficient for you, for my strength is made perfect in weakness. For the one who feels too weak tonight, let the power of Christ rest upon them in their weakness. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you are able to make all grace abound toward us, that we, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work. For the one facing a financial need tonight, provide for them abundantly. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, help us not be weary in well doing, for in due season we shall reap if we faint not. For the caregiver, the teacher, and the parent who feel unseen tonight, keep them from fainting. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you call us to bear one another's burdens and so fulfill the law of Christ. Send someone to help carry my friend's burden tonight, and make us people who help carry others. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you are able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think. For the dream or the prayer my friend has almost given up on tonight, do more than they can imagine. Unto you be glory in the church forever. Amen.

Father, let Christ dwell in my friend's heart by faith. Root and ground them in love, and help them grasp the breadth, and length, and depth, and height of the love of Christ, which passes knowledge. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, by grace we are saved through faith, and that not of ourselves; it is your gift, not of works. For the one trying to earn your love tonight, help them simply receive your free gift. In Jesus' name, amen.
Lord, make my friend strong in you and in the power of your might. Help them put on the whole armor of God, so they can stand against the wiles of the enemy tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, help us put away bitterness, wrath, and anger, and be kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as you for Christ's sake have forgiven us. Bring forgiveness into strained homes tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, help my friend be careful for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, make their requests known to you. Let your peace, which passes all understanding, keep their heart and mind tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you shall supply all our need according to your riches in glory by Christ Jesus. For the one worried about rent, groceries, or medicine tonight, supply their need from your endless riches. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, we can do all things through Christ who strengthens us. For the one facing a long shift, a hard treatment, or a difficult tomorrow, pour your strength into them hour by hour. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you who began a good work in us will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ. For the one discouraged by their slow progress tonight, remind them that you are not finished with them yet. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, help my friend forget those things which are behind and reach forth unto those things which are before. Let them press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus. In Jesus' name, amen.
Lord, help us do whatever we do heartily, as to you and not unto men. For the worker who feels unappreciated tonight, remind them they serve the Lord Christ, and you see it all. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, let the peace of God rule in our hearts, and let the word of Christ dwell in us richly, as we sing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs with grace in our hearts. Make these hymns tonight a true offering of worship. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, help us rejoice evermore, pray without ceasing, and in everything give thanks, for this is your will in Christ Jesus concerning us. Even tonight, help my friend find something to thank you for. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord of peace, give my friend peace always, by all means. Be with them tonight and every night, at home, at work, at a bedside, or on the road. Let your peace stand guard over them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you have not given us the spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind. For the one battling anxiety tonight, replace fear with your power, your love, and a sound mind. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you are a high priest who is touched with the feeling of our infirmities. Help my friend come boldly unto the throne of grace tonight, to obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. In your name, amen.

Lord, you said I will never leave you nor forsake you, so we may boldly say, the Lord is my helper, and I will not fear. For the one who has been left by others, let them know you will never leave. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, your word tells us to remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them. I lift up every prisoner listening tonight. Comfort them, guard them, and let them know they are not forgotten. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, the hope we have in you is an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast. For the one being tossed by waves tonight, let this hope hold them fast until the storm has passed. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, if any of us lacks wisdom, we may ask of you, for you give to all liberally and upbraid not. My friend needs wisdom for a decision tonight. Give it to them freely and clearly. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, your word says the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise them up. In faith, I pray now for everyone listening from a sickbed or a hospital room. Raise them up, Lord. In Jesus' name, amen.
Father, you told us to cast all our care upon you, for you care for us. Help my friend cast every care onto you tonight, one by one, and know how deeply you care for them. In Jesus' name, amen.

God of all grace, after we have suffered a while, you will make us perfect, stablish, strengthen, and settle us. For the one who has suffered long, bring the settling and strengthening they need. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, help your children not think it strange concerning the fiery trial. For believers suffering for your name tonight, let them rejoice that they share in your sufferings, and strengthen them to endure. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, by your abundant mercy you have begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus, to an inheritance that fades not away. For the one losing hope tonight, renew this living hope. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you are not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance. I pray for every listener who does not know you, and for the loved ones we have prayed for so long. Draw them to you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, if we confess our sins, you are faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. For the one holding onto secret shame tonight, let them confess and be clean. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, there is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear. Pour your perfect love into my friend tonight until there is no room left for fear in their heart or in their home. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, behold what manner of love you have bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God. For the one who never had a loving father, let them know they are your beloved child. In Jesus' name, amen.

Now unto him that is able to keep us from falling, and to present us faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy, be glory and majesty. Lord, keep my friend from falling tonight, and hold them fast. Amen.

Lord, you shall wipe away all tears from our eyes, and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither any more pain. For everyone in pain tonight, give them a glimpse of that day. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears your voice and opens the door, you will come in. For the one hearing you knock tonight, give them courage to open the door. In your name, amen.

Lord, one day a great multitude of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues will stand before your throne. Strengthen your church around the world tonight, especially those who worship you in secret and in danger. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you are worthy to receive glory and honor and power, for you have created all things, and for your pleasure they are and were created. Tonight we simply worship you for who you are. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, at midnight Paul and Silas prayed and sang praises unto you in a prison cell, and the prisoners heard them. For everyone in a prison tonight, of iron bars or of circumstances, give them a midnight song. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, as your early church prayed, grant unto your servants that with all boldness they may speak your word. Fill persecuted believers with your Holy Spirit and boldness tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, in the middle of a storm at sea, you sent your angel to tell Paul, fear not. For those working on ships, rigs, and boats tonight, keep them safe and let them be of good cheer. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, there is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus. For the one condemning themselves tonight, silence the accuser, and let them rest in your verdict of grace. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, your servant Paul wrote, I am crucified with Christ; nevertheless I live, yet not I, but Christ lives in me. Let my friend live tonight by faith in you, the Son of God, who loved them and gave yourself for them. In your name, amen.

Father, after your kindness and love toward man appeared, you saved us, not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to your mercy. Thank you for that mercy tonight. Let my friend receive it fully. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, the weapons of our warfare are mighty through you to the pulling down of strongholds. Help my friend bring every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ tonight, every anxious thought and every lie. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, not one sparrow falls to the ground without you, and even the hairs of our head are all numbered. For the one who feels insignificant tonight, remind them they are of more value than many sparrows. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you told your weary disciples, come apart into a desert place, and rest awhile. For the nurse on her break and the worker who has not stopped all day, give them true rest in you, even for a few moments. In your name, amen.

Father, eye has not seen, nor ear heard, neither has entered into the heart of man, the things you have prepared for them that love you. For the one who is tired of this world tonight, lift their eyes to what you have prepared. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you hear my voice in the morning, and in the morning I will direct my prayer to you and look up. For my friend listening tonight who is counting the hours until dawn, help them lay every worry before you now, and wake to look up with hope. In Jesus' name, amen.

Heavenly Father, your word says my heart instructs me in the night seasons, and because you are at my right hand I shall not be moved. Instruct my friend in these quiet hours. Set yourself before them, steady and near, so nothing tonight can shake them loose from you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, keep the one listening tonight as the apple of your eye, and hide them under the shadow of your wings. Whatever they are carrying in this dark hour, let them feel how precious they are to you, and let them rest there, covered and cared for. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Lord, you light my candle and you lighten my darkness. For the one sitting in a dim room tonight, unable to see the way forward, kindle a small flame of hope in their heart. Shine into the shadows they cannot fix, and show them you are already there. In Jesus' name, amen.

Creator God, the heavens declare your glory and the sky above us shows your handiwork. As my friend glances out the window at the night sky, let every star remind them that the One who made all this is the same One who loves them and keeps them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord our Lord, when we consider your heavens, the moon and the stars which you have ordained, we wonder what we are that you are mindful of us. Yet you are. Tonight, tell the one who feels small and forgotten that you remember them by name. In Jesus' precious name, amen.

Gracious Father, your word says wait on the Lord, be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart. For the one waiting tonight on test results, on a phone call, on an answer that has not come, give them courage for the waiting and strength for the heart. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, you are my strength and my shield, and my heart trusted in you and I am helped. Be a shield tonight around my friend listening, and be their strength when they are too tired to stand. Turn their worry into a quiet song of thanks before morning. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Mighty God, you give strength to your people and you bless your people with peace. I ask both for the night-shift worker hearing this right now. Strength for the hours still ahead, and peace in the middle of the busy and the beeping. Carry them to the end of the shift. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father in heaven, your word says be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all you that hope in the Lord. Some of us are holding on to hope by a thread tonight. Strengthen that thread, Lord, and let it hold. Pour courage into tired hearts. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, our soul waits for you. You are our help and our shield, and our hearts rejoice because we have trusted in your holy name. Let your mercy rest on my friend listening tonight, according as they hope in you. Be their help when no other help is near. In Jesus' name, amen.

How excellent is your lovingkindness, O God. The children of men put their trust under the shadow of your wings. Tonight I pray for the one who has run out of places to hide. Gather them under those wings, Lord, warm and safe until the morning comes. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Heavenly Father, you tell us to rest in the Lord and wait patiently for him, and not to fret. For the anxious mind replaying the day over and over, quiet the fretting. Teach my friend to rest in you tonight, trusting that you are working even while they sleep. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, all my desire is before you, and my groaning is not hidden from you. For the one lying awake with an ache too deep for words, let them know you hear even the sighs. Nothing they feel tonight is hidden from your tender eyes. Meet them in the groaning. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, what am I waiting for? My hope is in you. For my friend who has watched other hopes fade, plant their hope in you again tonight. You do not fade, you do not fail, and you do not leave. Be the hope that carries them to the morning light. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Father, your word says the Lord will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me. Let your song be with the one listening right now. When the house is quiet and the heart is heavy, let a hymn rise up inside them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, send out your light and your truth, and let them lead me. For the one who has wandered into confusion and cannot find their way home, send your light tonight. Lead them gently back to your holy hill, back to the place where they first met you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Be merciful to us, O God, for our souls trust in you. In the shadow of your wings we make our refuge until these calamities be overpast. For my friend caught in a hard season tonight, be their refuge until it is over. And Lord, let it pass. In the strong name of Jesus, amen.

Father, from the end of the earth I will cry to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I. For the one who feels miles from anywhere tonight, lift them up onto that rock. Let them stand above the flood on something solid. In Jesus' name, amen.

Truly my soul waits upon God, for from him comes my salvation. He only is my rock. Lord, for the one who has leaned on everything else and found it wobbly, let them lean on you tonight. You are the rock that does not move, and they shall not be greatly moved. In Jesus' name, amen.

Gracious God, you make the outgoings of the morning and the evening to rejoice. Thank you for this night and for the morning already on its way. For my friend listening in the in-between hours, let them sense the quiet joy you have tucked into every sunset and sunrise. In Jesus' name, amen.

Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me. Father, some of us have wondered lately if you are still listening. Remind my friend tonight that you have never turned away one honest prayer, and never once withdrawn your mercy. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Lord God, the day is yours and the night also is yours. You prepared the light and the sun. These dark hours belong to you as much as the bright ones. So for everyone awake right now, be Lord of this night. Rule over it with your peace and your kindness. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, I will hear what God the Lord will speak, for he will speak peace to his people. In the stillness of this house tonight, speak peace to my friend listening. Hush the other voices, the worries and the what-ifs, and let your voice be the one they hear. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, in the day of my trouble I will call upon you, for you will answer me. And in the night of trouble too. For the one calling out to you right now in the dark, answer them, Lord. Let them know their cry has reached your ear and your heart. In the precious name of Jesus, amen.

Faithful God, I will sing of your mercies forever, and with my mouth make known your faithfulness to all generations. Thank you for mercies we cannot count. As these old hymns play tonight, let my friend join the long line of saints who have sung of your goodness. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, cover my friend with your feathers tonight, and under your wings let them trust. Your truth is their shield and buckler. Let them not be afraid for the terror by night, nor the arrow that flies by day. Guard their dreams and guard their rest. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, it is a good thing to give thanks to you, to show forth your lovingkindness in the morning and your faithfulness every night. So tonight we say thank you. Thank you for being faithful through this whole day, and faithful through every hour still to come. In Jesus' name, amen.

Heavenly Father, as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is your mercy toward those who fear you. As far as the east is from the west, so far have you removed our transgressions. For the one replaying old failures tonight, let them rest in that distance. In Jesus' name, amen.

Creator Lord, you appointed the moon for seasons and the sun knows its going down. You make darkness and it is night. You set the rhythm of rest, and it is good. Help my friend tonight to trust that rhythm, to lay down the day, and let you keep the world turning. In Jesus' name, amen.

Gracious God, you satisfy the longing soul and fill the hungry soul with goodness. For the one aching with an emptiness that nothing has filled, I pray you would fill it tonight. Not with more things, but with yourself. Let them taste your goodness and be satisfied. In the name of Jesus, amen.

From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, the name of the Lord is to be praised. And Father, in the deep middle of the night too. So we praise you now. Receive the quiet worship of everyone listening, the whispered thanks of tired hearts. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, I love you because you have heard my voice and my supplications. You have inclined your ear to me. Picture that, Father, you leaning down to listen. Lean close to my friend tonight, and let them call on you as long as they live, knowing you hear. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, your word says return to your rest, O my soul, for the Lord has dealt bountifully with you. For the soul that has wandered far from rest tonight, call it home. Remind my friend of every kindness you have shown them, and let that memory settle them to sleep. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, this is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has quickened me. For the one suffering tonight in body or in spirit, let some word of yours come alive to them. A verse remembered, a hymn line, a promise. Let it lift them and give them life. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Lord, I have remembered your name in the night and have kept your law. For my friend who cannot sleep, let your name be the first thing their heart remembers. When the mind wanders to fear, bring it back to you, and let your name be their resting place. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, at midnight I will rise to give thanks to you because of your righteous judgments. Here we are at midnight and beyond, Lord, and we give thanks. Thank you for being just and good and near. Turn sleepless hours into thankful hours for everyone listening. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, let your merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant. For the grieving one in the quiet house tonight, wrap them in that merciful kindness. Be the comfort no one else can give. Hold them through this night and the next. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you are my hiding place and my shield, and I hope in your word. For my friend who needs somewhere safe to hide tonight, from worry, from hurt, from the noise of the world, be that place. Shield them, and let them hope again in what you have said. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother. For the restless heart listening tonight, quiet it like that. Like a little one finally settled in a parent's arms. Let my friend stop striving and simply rest against you. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Lord, bless all you servants who by night stand in your house. Father, bless the night watchers. The nurses, the guards, the truckers, the mothers up with a fever. Let them lift up their hands to you even while they work, and bless them out of Zion. In Jesus' name, amen.

O give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his mercy endures forever. Father, we thank you that your mercy did not run out today and will not run out tonight. Forever is a long time, and your mercy outlasts all of it. Let my friend rest in that. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, if I say surely the darkness shall cover me, even the night shall be light about me. The darkness hides not from you, the night shines as the day. For the one who feels lost in the dark tonight, let them know they are fully seen and fully known by you. In Jesus' name, amen.

How precious are your thoughts toward us, O God. They are more in number than the sand. And when I awake, I am still with you. Father, as my friend drifts off tonight, let that be their last thought, and in the morning let it be true again. Still with you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, let my prayer be set before you as incense, and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice. Receive the prayers rising from kitchens and hospital rooms and truck cabs tonight. Let them be a sweet fragrance to you, every whispered word of them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you are near to all who call upon you, to all who call upon you in truth. For the one who thinks you are far away tonight, draw near. You do not need fancy words, only an honest heart. Let my friend call on you right now and find you close. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Gracious God, you tell the number of the stars and call them all by their names. If you know every star, you surely know my friend listening tonight. You know their name, their worry, their story. Let them rest knowing they are not lost in the crowd to you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Praise him, sun and moon. Praise him, all you stars of light. Father, the whole night sky is worshiping you right now. Let us join in. From every bedside and night shift and quiet porch, receive our praise, small as it is, joined with the shining of the stars. In Jesus' name, amen.

Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Father, for every breath we have drawn today, thank you. For the one breathing slowly and with effort tonight, sustain each breath. And let every breath, easy or hard, become a small song of praise to you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Faithful Father, you are a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble. Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you have not forsaken those who seek you. My friend is seeking you tonight. Do not let them feel forsaken. Be their refuge. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, I have trusted in your mercy, and my heart shall rejoice in your salvation. I will sing to the Lord, because he has dealt bountifully with me. For the one who began this night asking how long, Lord, bring them to this place of trust and song. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, may the Lord hear you in the day of trouble, and the name of the God of Jacob defend you. I pray that over my friend listening tonight. Whatever trouble came to their door today, hear them, defend them, and send them help from your holy place. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Lord, turn to me and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted. For the lonely one tonight who feels utterly alone in a quiet house, turn your face toward them. Let them sense your nearness in the stillness. They are not as alone as they feel. In Jesus' name, amen.

Faithful Father, I sought the Lord and he heard me and delivered me from all my fears. Not some of them, all of them. For the anxious mind tonight with a list of fears too long to count, hear them as they seek you, and deliver them, one fear at a time. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, your word says O taste and see that the Lord is good. Blessed is the one who trusts in him. For my friend who has only heard about you secondhand, let them taste and see for themselves tonight. Let them find out how good you really are. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Father, this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even unto death. For the one sitting tonight beside a loved one near the end, be their guide. Guide the one who is leaving and the one who must stay. You know the way through. In Jesus' name, amen.

Faithful Father, you have taught me from my youth. Now also when I am old and grayheaded, do not forsake me. For the older saints listening tonight, thank you for their long faithfulness. Stay close in these later years, and let them still tell of your strength. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, your word says the righteous shall still bring forth fruit in old age. For the elderly friend who wonders if their life still matters, remind them tonight that it does. Their prayers, their wisdom, their love still bear fruit for your kingdom. In Jesus' name, amen.

Merciful Lord, you uphold all that fall, and raise up all those that are bowed down. For the one who stumbled today, who fell short and feels it tonight, lift them up. For the one bowed low with sorrow, raise their head. You are the God who picks us up. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, you have turned my mourning into dancing and girded me with gladness. For the grieving heart tonight, that day may feel impossibly far away. But hold them in the mourning, and in your time, let gladness come again. Not forgetting, but healing. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, behold, God is my salvation. I will trust and not be afraid, for the Lord is my strength and my song. For my friend who is afraid tonight, let this be their confession. I will trust and not be afraid. Be their strength, and give them a song again. In Jesus' name, amen.

Merciful Lord, your word promises your people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places. Make every home where this music is playing a peaceable habitation tonight. A sure dwelling and a quiet resting place. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Lord, strengthen the weak hands and confirm the feeble knees. Say to them of a fearful heart, be strong, fear not, your God will come. For the one whose hands are tired and heart is fearful tonight, speak those words over them. You will come. In Jesus' name, amen.

Holy One, you tell us to lift up our eyes and see who created all these stars. You bring out their host by number and call them all by names, and not one fails. If not one star goes missing, Lord, then my friend tonight is not missing to you either. In Jesus' name, amen.

Everlasting God, you do not faint and you are not weary. We are, Lord. So weary. For the caregiver, the new parent, the worker on a double shift, thank you that you never run out of strength. Lend them some of yours tonight. In the precious name of Jesus, amen.

Lord my God, you hold my right hand and say to me, fear not, I will help you. For my friend reaching out in the dark tonight, take their hand. Hold it firmly. Speak those words softly into their heart. Fear not, I will help you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Merciful Lord, you created us and formed us, and you say fear not, for I have redeemed you, I have called you by your name, you are mine. Let the one listening tonight hear their own name in that promise. They belong to you. Nothing can change that. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, your word speaks to the one who walks in darkness and has no light, telling them to trust in the name of the Lord and stay upon their God. That is my friend tonight. No light yet. So help them trust your name and lean their whole weight on you. In Jesus' name, amen.

High and Holy One, you dwell in the high and holy place, and also with the one who has a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the heart. For the broken and humbled heart tonight, come dwell with them. Revive what feels dead inside. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Dear Lord, your word says arise, shine, for your light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon you. Morning is coming, Lord. For my friend who has been in the dark a long while, let the first light of your glory rise over them soon. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, in all their affliction you were afflicted, and the angel of your presence saved them. In your love and pity you carried them all the days of old. For the suffering one tonight, thank you that you feel it with them. Carry them now as you carried your people then. In Jesus' name, amen.

Dear Lord, you are our Father. We are the clay and you are the potter, and we all are the work of your hand. For the one who feels broken and misshapen tonight, remind them they are still in your hands. You are not finished shaping them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Dear Lord, you promised that before they call, I will answer, and while they are yet speaking, I will hear. Thank you that you are already at work on prayers my friend has not even finished praying. Let them rest tonight in that kind of attention. In Jesus' name, amen.

Holy Father, you said as one whom his mother comforts, so will I comfort you. For the one who needs that kind of comfort tonight, the gentle, close, rocking kind, give it to them. Hold them like a mother holds a hurting child until they sleep. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Holy Father, you promised to give treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that we may know you are the Lord who calls us by name. For the one in a dark season tonight, let them find some hidden treasure of your presence here. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, with my soul I have desired you in the night, and with my spirit within me I will seek you early. For my friend whose soul is reaching for you in these late hours, meet that longing. Be found by the one who seeks you tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, the grass withers and the flower fades, but the word of our God shall stand forever. So much is changing for my friend tonight. Health, family, plans. Let them stand on your word, which does not wither and does not fade. In the name of Jesus, amen.

God who sees, Hagar called you the God who sees me, when she was alone and running in the wilderness. For the one who feels unseen tonight, overlooked and forgotten, let them know you see them right now. Every tear, every sigh. You see. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, Jacob wrestled through the night until the breaking of the day and would not let go until you blessed him. For the one wrestling tonight with questions and with pain, hold on to them as they hold on to you. And at daybreak, bless them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Holy Father, you went before your people by day in a pillar of cloud and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light. For the traveler on a dark road tonight, go before them. Light their way. Lead them mile by mile until they arrive safely home. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, the Lord is my strength and song, and he has become my salvation. He is my God and I will praise him. As we listen to these old hymns tonight, be our strength and our song. Let our hearts sing back to you in gratitude. In the strong name of Jesus, amen.

Lord, your word says the beloved of the Lord shall dwell in safety by him, and he shall cover him all the day long. Let my friend listening rest tonight as your beloved. Safe by you, covered by you, all the day long and all the night through. In Jesus' name, amen.

Kind Father, you called young Samuel in the night, and he answered, speak, for your servant hears. Speak to my friend in the quiet of this night. Give them ears to hear your voice and a willing heart to answer. In the precious name of Jesus, amen.

Kind Father, you were not in the wind or the earthquake or the fire, but in a still small voice. In the hush of this late hour, speak to the one listening in that gentle whisper. Quiet the loud things so they can hear you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord, Elisha told his frightened servant, fear not, for they that be with us are more than they that be with them. Then you opened his eyes. For the one who feels outnumbered tonight, open their eyes to your unseen protection. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, David sang, you are my lamp, O Lord, and the Lord will lighten my darkness. Be a lamp tonight in every dark room and every dark heart. A gentle light, just enough for the next step. And by it, let my friend see you beside them. In the name of Jesus, amen.

God my Maker, your word says you give songs in the night. Thank you for the hymns that have carried us through so many dark hours. Give a song tonight to the one who has lost theirs. Let a melody of hope rise in them again. In Jesus' name, amen.

Kind Father, your word says when you lie down you shall not be afraid, yes, you shall lie down and your sleep shall be sweet. For my friend about to lie down tonight, take away the fear. Make their sleep sweet and deep and healing. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, the sleep of a laboring man is sweet. For every worker who will come home at dawn after a long night shift, give them that sweet sleep. Darken their room, quiet their neighborhood, and let their rest be deep. In Jesus' name, amen.

O Lord, you are good to those who wait for you, to the soul that seeks you. It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord. Teach us to wait quietly tonight, my friend and me, with hope. In Jesus' name, amen.

O Lord, your word says arise, cry out in the night, pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord, lift up your hands for the life of your young children. For parents praying over their little ones tonight, hear every word. In Jesus' name, amen.

O Lord, your going forth is prepared as the morning, and you shall come to us as the rain. As sure as the sunrise, you will come. For the one in a long night of waiting, let them hold on to that certainty. Morning is coming, and so are you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, the Lord is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble, and he knows them that trust in him. You know my friend tonight. You know their trouble and you know their trust, small as it may feel. Be their stronghold. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Lord, who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity and delights in mercy? You will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea. For the one weighed down by guilt tonight, let them leave it in those depths and sleep forgiven. In Jesus' name, amen.

Almighty God, your word says the winter is past, the rain is over and gone, the flowers appear on the earth. For the one in a long winter of the heart tonight, hold them through the cold. And in your time, let spring come again. In Jesus' name, amen.

Almighty God, Jesus said you know what things we have need of before we ask. You already know what my friend listening needs tonight, better than they do. Supply it, Lord. Rest, provision, healing, peace. You know. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, in Gethsemane you asked your friends to watch with you, and you know how heavy the night can be. For those keeping vigil tonight beside a hospital bed, strengthen them to watch, and let them know you are watching with them. In your name, amen.

Father, Jesus said ask and it shall be given you, seek and you shall find, knock and it shall be opened. For the one asking tonight, give. For the one seeking, be found. For the one knocking at your door in the dark, open. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, rising up a great while before day, you went out to a solitary place and prayed. You know these early hours. For my friend awake before the dawn, let this become a solitary place with you, a quiet meeting with the Father. In your name, amen.

Lord, the father in the gospel cried, I believe, help my unbelief. That is an honest prayer, and some of us pray it tonight. Meet the one whose faith is shaky right now. Take what little belief they have and help it grow. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Almighty God, the first news of a Savior came to shepherds keeping watch over their flock by night. Thank you for honoring the night workers. Bring good tidings of great joy to everyone on the night shift tonight, and let them meet the Savior too. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord Jesus, you went out to a mountain to pray and continued all night in prayer to God. You know what it is to spend a whole night with the Father. For the one praying through this night, keep them company, and carry their prayers home. In your name, amen.

Father, Jesus told of a friend who knocked at midnight asking for bread and kept on asking until he received. For the one knocking on heaven's door at midnight tonight, give them boldness to keep asking, and answer from your kindness. In Jesus' name, amen.

Jesus, the travelers to Emmaus said abide with us, for it is toward evening and the day is far spent. We pray the same tonight. Abide with my friend listening. Sit at their table, walk beside their bed, stay through the night. In your precious name, amen.

Jesus, the light shines in darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it. For the one in a dark place tonight, shine. Let them know the darkness around them does not get the final word. Your light does. Always. In your holy name, amen.

Father, Nicodemus came to Jesus by night, full of questions. For my friend far from you who is wondering tonight, let them come too. Questions and all. Meet them as kindly as Jesus met Nicodemus, and show them new life. In Jesus' name, amen.

Jesus, you said I am the bread of life. He that comes to me shall never hunger, and he that believes on me shall never thirst. For the hungry heart tonight, be their bread. For the thirsty soul, satisfy them with yourself. In your name, amen.

Jesus, you promised I will not leave you comfortless, I will come to you. For the one who feels comfortless tonight, abandoned and alone, come to them. Send your Holy Spirit as their comforter in this lonely hour. In your precious name, amen.

Jesus, when your frightened disciples sat behind shut doors in the evening, you came and stood among them and said peace be unto you. Come through the closed doors of fear tonight, and stand in the room with my friend. Speak peace. In your name, amen.

Jesus, your disciples fished all night and caught nothing, and in the morning you stood on the shore. For the one who has worked hard all night with nothing to show for it, let them see you on the shore at dawn. In your holy name, amen.

Father, Peter slept soundly between two soldiers the night before his trial, and your angel came with a light into the prison. For the one facing a hard tomorrow, give them peace enough to sleep tonight, and send your help. In Jesus' name, amen.

Abba Father, your word says you are not far from every one of us, for in you we live and move and have our being. For my friend who has drifted far from you, show them tonight that you are nearer than their next breath. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Father, help us to be rejoicing in hope, patient in tribulation, and continuing steadfast in prayer. For my friend in a long trial tonight, give them patience. Keep hope alive in them, and keep them talking to you. In Jesus' name, amen.

God of hope, fill my friend listening tonight with all joy and peace in believing, that they may abound in hope through the power of the Holy Ghost. Fill them up, Lord, until hope spills over. In the name of Jesus, amen.

Father, though our outward man perish, our inward man is renewed day by day. For the one whose body is weakening tonight, renew them inwardly. Help them look not at what is seen, but at what is eternal. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, like Paul I bow my knees to you, from whom every family in heaven and earth is named. Strengthen my friend listening tonight with might by your Spirit in the inner man, according to the riches of your glory. In Jesus' name, amen.

Abba Father, your word says whatever things are true, honest, just, pure, lovely and of good report, think on these things. For the anxious mind spinning tonight, turn their thoughts toward what is lovely and true. Toward you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Jesus, you are before all things, and by you all things consist. You hold the stars in place and you hold my friend's life together tonight. When everything feels like it is coming apart, hold it together. In your mighty name, amen.

Good Shepherd, you died for us, that whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with you. So whether my friend lies awake tonight or drifts into sleep, let them be with you. Awake or asleep, they are yours. In your name, amen.

Father, help us run with patience the race set before us, looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith. For the one who is tired of running tonight, lift their eyes to Jesus. He started this, and he will finish it. Amen.

Lord, help us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering, for you are faithful that promised. For my friend whose grip is slipping tonight, hold on to them. Your faithfulness does not depend on ours. In Jesus' name, amen.

Abba Father, your word says draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. For the one listening who has been far away for a long while, let them take one small step toward you tonight. And let them find you already running to meet them. In Jesus' name, amen.

Good Shepherd, we were as sheep going astray, but are now returned to the Shepherd and Bishop of our souls. For the wandering one tonight, bring them back. Guard their soul, and let them come home to you. In Jesus' name, amen.

Precious Lord, your eyes are over the righteous and your ears are open to their prayers. Thank you that your eyes are on my friend right now, and your ears are open to every word they pray tonight. Let them pray freely. In Jesus' name, amen.

Father, we have known and believed the love that God has to us. God is love, and he that dwells in love dwells in God. Let my friend dwell in your love tonight. Let it be the room they rest in, the blanket they sleep under. In Jesus' name, amen.

Lord God, your word says there shall be no night there, and they need no candle, neither light of the sun, for the Lord God gives them light. For the one weary of long nights, give them a glimpse of that endless morning. In Jesus' name, amen.

Good Shepherd, you laid your right hand on John and said fear not, I am the first and the last. I am he that lives and was dead, and behold, I am alive forevermore. Lay that same hand on my friend tonight and quiet their fear. In your name, amen.

Gentle Savior, you said I was sick and you visited me. Bless every caregiver tonight who sits with the sick, the aging parent, the hurting spouse. Let them see your face in the one they care for, and let them feel your care for them. In your name, amen.

Precious Lord, your word says the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you and keep you from evil. Keep my friend listening tonight. Guard their home, their mind and their heart. Establish them on solid ground for the morning ahead. In Jesus' name, amen.
